claims.statement: In the rank-491 matching sector with 736 two-vertex color classes, every source subfamily A has ordinary deletion boundary D(A) satisfying 491|A| <= 492|D(A)|; equality holds for the full level, leaving an exact deletion-only shortfall equal to one 492nd of its source level.
claims.scope: Only ordinary deletions in the specified CB(8,92) hub-and-arm matching sector; no insertion arcs or external competing demands.
claims.reason: Exact double counting of deletion edges proves the arbitrary-subfamily inequality; the full-level product counts attain equality. This is a sector bound, not a mixed-boundary or aggregate proof.

limitations: The bound does not analyze support-insertion targets or whether their capacity survives competing demands from other source families.
No compression preserving both deletion and insertion boundaries was established.
No complete selected-tag Hall inequality, refutation, or all-parameter result is proved.
